blocks.x: Hybrid wind-solar-storage forecasting, imbalance costs down 28% and the trading desk finally trusts its own numbers

A renewable energy developer: Utility operations carry physical consequence: a forecasting miss or an asset failure cascades fast. The Achala program started where that consequence concentrates —. The baseline signed in week two made the cost visible in units the finance team already owns, and the engagement ran under the standard Achala charter — a named metric, a named control owner and gates that evidence every move.

The baseline year priced the weather: imbalance costs rising with fleet share, forecasts from a vendor ensemble the desk couldn't interrogate, and curtailment decisions made by rule of thumb at 15:00 for the evening peak.
Wind and solar forecasts lived apart, storage offered nothing to the forecast, and the desk's own adjustments were folklore nobody scored.

We built the hybrid forecast spine: ensemble weather models fused per site with the operator's own SCADA truth, storage dispatch co-optimized into the forecast, desk adjustments structured and scored weekly so folklore either delivers results or retires, and imbalance exposure reported per asset. The desk stopped betting against itself.
